---
title: "Job Application 1 Rubric"
---

Resume Rubric

| **Criteria**            | **Excellent (5)**                                                                 | **Good (4)**                                                                 | **Average (3)**                                                              | **Needs Improvement (2)**                                                    | **Poor (1)**                                                                 |
|-------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Contact Information** | Complete, professional, and easy to find.                                         | Complete and professional.                                                   | Complete but not easily found.                                               | Incomplete or unprofessional.                                                | Missing or very unprofessional.                                              |
| **Skills**    | Comprehensive list of relevant technical skills, including proficiency levels.    | Good list of relevant technical skills.                                      | Adequate list, but missing some key skills.                                  | Limited list of relevant skills.                                             | Missing or irrelevant skills listed.                                         |
| **Experience**          | Detailed descriptions of relevant experience, with quantifiable achievements.     | Good descriptions of relevant experience, with some quantifiable achievements.| Adequate descriptions, but lacks quantifiable achievements.                  | Limited descriptions, with few or no quantifiable achievements.              | Missing or irrelevant experience listed.                                     |
| **Education**           | Relevant degrees or certifications, with details on coursework or projects.       | Relevant degrees or certifications.                                          | Adequate education listed, but lacks detail.                                 | Limited education listed, with little relevance to the role.                 | Missing or irrelevant education listed.                                      |
| **Projects**            | Detailed descriptions of relevant projects, with clear outcomes and technologies used.| Good descriptions of relevant projects.                                      | Adequate descriptions, but lacks detail on outcomes or technologies used.    | Limited descriptions, with few or no relevant projects listed.               | Missing or irrelevant projects listed.                                       |
| **Soft Skills**         | Clear evidence of communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills.            | Good evidence of soft skills.                                                | Adequate evidence, but lacks detail.                                         | Limited evidence of soft skills.                                             | Missing or irrelevant soft skills listed.                                    |
| **Formatting**          | Professional, clean, and easy to read, with consistent formatting.                | Professional and easy to read, with minor formatting inconsistencies.         | Adequate formatting, but some sections are hard to read.                     | Poor formatting, with multiple inconsistencies.                              | Unprofessional and hard to read.                                             |
| **Overall Impression**  | Strong candidate with a well-rounded resume that stands out.                      | Good candidate with a solid resume.                                          | Adequate candidate, but resume lacks some key elements.                      | Weak candidate, with a resume that needs significant improvement.            | Very weak candidate, with a poorly constructed resume.                       |
```
